website.error: Medical device / digital health company; no drug pipeline page

ctgov.note: All 11 P1/P3 records are device studies (CPAP, VPAP, masks, ventilators) for sleep-disordered breathing. ResMed-led trials are all COMPLETED (NCT01395693 mask, NCT02683772 Astral VAPS, NCT00252252 AutoVPAP). Remaining trials are investigator-initiated studies led by academic institutions (Johns Hopkins, Yale, Adelaide, WashU, Kaiserswerther Diakonie) where ResMed or ResMed Foundation only provides device or grant support; statuses are COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN, or RECRUITING but not ResMed-sponsored. None qualify as active P1/P2/P3 drug development by the company.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ResMed is a sleep, respiratory care, and digital health medical device and SaaS company. It has no proprietary drug pipeline. All ctgov P1/P3 hits are device studies; ResMed-sponsored trials in the registry are all completed legacy device studies, and active trials are investigator-initiated (Yale NHLBI, Johns Hopkins, Adelaide, WashU, Kaiserswerther) where ResMed or ResMed Foundation only provides device or grant support. No active P1/P2/P3 drug development by the company.
